description: Source code for the HLSLCompiler class, responsible for compiling HLSL shaders to binary form, disassembling binaries, and managing the D3D compiler library within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: HLSLCompiler
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the D3D HLSL shader compiler, including loading the compiler DLL, compiling shaders, and disassembling binaries.

classes.name: CompileConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for shader compilation flags and name.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the HLSL compiler by loading the DLL and retrieving function pointers.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the compiler, including unloading the DLL.

methods.name: compileToBinary
methods.description: Compiles HLSL source code into binary blob with specified configurations and optional macros.

methods.name: disassembleBinary
methods.description: Disassembles a compiled shader binary into human-readable assembly code.
